title: I LOVE These 3 Stocks — But I'm NOT Buying Yet
creator: Mark Roussin CPA
summary: His 'Don't fight the Fed' Investors Weekly Playbook: after the Fed's 25bp hike (first since 2023), 10Y Treasury above 5%, and signals of more hikes, he argues valuations matter more and is building a shopping list rather than buying — great companies don't automatically equal great investments at any price. AAPL: CONDITIONAL_BUY at ~$342 (avg analyst PT equals current price, no upside); amazing ecosystem business, but 36.7x forward PE on single-digit growth and 28x forward EV/EBITDA vs 5-year average 22x — he needs a better entry to justify the required return with risk-free rates rising. CRWD: CONDITIONAL_BUY at ~$260 (avg PT $234, ~10% below price); best quarter ever with ARR $5.8B (+25%) and record $333M net new ARR, but 186x forward PE / 126x forward EV/EBITDA / 40x forward sales — premium justified, but so much is priced in that any growth slowdown risks multiple compression; he'd buy a selloff. ABBV: CONDITIONAL_BUY at $260 (he urged buying under $200; it's his top holding); immunology franchise executing superbly (Skyrizi $5.5B +24%, Rinvoq $2.5B +25%, Humira -36% offset), but 17.5x forward PE offers no margin of safety for pharma-specific risks (patent cliffs, trial failures, pricing pressure) — he waits for a better price. Macro backdrop: S&P flat in September, Nasdaq +2%, Dow -3%, Russell 2000 -4%; CPI still elevated (Fed projects 3.7% 2026 PCE). Verdict: loves all three businesses, none is buyable at current valuations; he'll be ready if volatility delivers his prices. (Caption auto-text renders ABBV as 'AVY'.)
